# p0_entra_agent_identity_creator_staged (Resource)

A staged Entra Agent Identity Creator installation for a Microsoft Entra directory. Staging picks the P0 service account that calls the connector, which the connector's app registration must trust.

Use the read-only `service_account_id` attribute as the subject of that app registration's federated identity credential, and deploy the connector's Container App with the same `app_role_allowlist`. Once the connector is deployed, create a `p0_entra_agent_identity_creator` resource with the same `directory_id` to complete the installation.

**Prerequisites:** An Azure subscription that trusts the directory, and a P0 gateway, whose issuer the connector trusts.

A directory connects to one P0 organization, and P0 refuses to stage a directory that another P0 organization already uses. Each directory gets its own P0 service account, so for another service account, install the Entra Agent Identity Creator for another directory.

**Note:** This integration is currently in preview.

For the full install steps, see [Entra Agent Identity Creator](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/resource-integrations/entra-agent-identity-creator).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Staging picks the P0 service account that calls the connector. Its
# service_account_id is the subject of the federated identity credential on the
# connector's app registration. See the p0_entra_agent_identity_creator example
# for the full chain.
resource "p0_entra_agent_identity_creator_staged" "example" {
  directory_id    = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  subscription_id = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  region          = "eastus"
  # Also the connector's P0_APP_ROLE_ALLOWLIST: keep the two the same.
  app_role_allowlist = "Sites.Selected"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_role_allowlist` (String) The Microsoft Graph app roles a per-grant app may hold, separated by commas, e.g. `Sites.Selected,User.Read.All`. The connector refuses any other. Set the connector's `P0_APP_ROLE_ALLOWLIST` environment variable to the same value.
- `directory_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra directory (tenant) ID, in lowercase, that P0 creates an app registration in for each agentic grant
- `region` (String) The Azure region the connector runs in, e.g. `eastus`
- `subscription_id` (String) The Azure subscription ID, in lowercase, that the connector's Container App is deployed in

### Read-Only

- `service_account_email` (String) The email of the P0 service account that calls the connector
- `service_account_id` (String) The numeric ID of the P0 service account that calls the connector. The connector of every Microsoft 365 integration in the directory trusts this account: the connector's app registration names it as the subject of a federated identity credential with issuer `https://accounts.google.com`.
- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed
